note: Each assembly is split into independent OpenZL v27 frames. Q equals the uncompressed frame target (64 KiB or 1 MiB); LZ windowLog is separately fixed at 16 or 20. Sidecar-equivalent frame index records compressed offset/length and uncompressed offset/length.

window_law.Q: actual independently decoded segment size; measure from produced frame/segment geometry
window_law.D_Q: one-thread full decode on ace-core after synthetic CI gate

enable_gate: all four segmented variants plus >1.6 GiB regression must round-trip bit-perfect and fetch must equal samtools before measurements_allowed=true
